diagnostics.message: The `null_resource.update_app` local-exec provisioner reconfigures the GitHub App webhook to point at `var.webhook_endpoint` and sends a ping to it. The endpoint value it depends on (`module.runners.webhook.endpoint`) is derived from the API Gateway API resource (`aws_apigatewayv2_api.webhook.api_endpoint`) alone, so the dependency chain reaches the API but not the `$default` stage that actually serves traffic (nor the route/integration behind it). Because `aws_apigatewayv2_stage.webhook` has no attribute reference back into the null_resource's chain, the provisioner can run before the stage exists/is deployed and the GitHub App is pointed at an endpoint that does not yet accept events. The ordering needs an explicit `depends_on` (the module does not export the stage, so no data reference is available).
